legend: Haunted houses are one of the most popular Halloween attractions. Bob plans to open his own haunted house for Halloween this year. His haunted house consists of N$$$N$$$ rooms numbered from 0$$$0$$$ to N−1$$$N-1$$$.

Bob has N$$$N$$$ ghosts and each of them has a unique energy value between 1$$$1$$$ and N$$$N$$$. A ghost with energy x$$$x$$$ can be active for x$$$x$$$ consecutive seconds, and then it needs to rest for x$$$x$$$ seconds until it can be active again. But there is one more flaw, if that ghost scares a person while it's active, then it needs to rest immediately for x$$$x$$$ seconds until it can be active again, since scaring people is tiring for ghosts.

Before deciding where to place the ghosts, Bob wants to simulate some scenarios. A scenario is defined by a permutation p0,p1,…,pN−1$$$p_0, p_1, \dots, p_{N-1}$$$, indicating that Bob places a ghost with energy pi$$$p_i$$$ in the room i$$$i$$$, and a sequence t0,t1,…,tM−1$$$t_0, t_1, \dots, t_{M-1}$$$, indicating the arriving time of people to the haunted house.
If a person arrives to the house at second tj$$$t_j$$$, then they visit the cell 0$$$0$$$ at second tj$$$t_j$$$. When a person visits the cell i$$$i$$$ at second T$$$T$$$, there are two cases:
If there is an active ghost in the room, then the person gets scared and abandons the house immediately. The ghost starts resting at second T+1$$$T+1$$$.
Otherwise, the person visits to the room i+1$$$i+1$$$ at second T+1$$$T+1$$$ or abandons the house if i+1=N$$$i+1=N$$$.
You are given a scenario, help Bob to simulate it and find what is the room where the people get scared and the second when that happens. Note that all ghosts start being active at second 0$$$0$$$.
input: The first line contains two integers N$$$N$$$ and M$$$M$$$ (1≤N,M≤105$$$1 \leq N, M \leq 10^5$$$). The second line contains a permutation p0,p1,…,pN−1$$$p_0, p_1, \dots, p_{N-1}$$$ of size N$$$N$$$ (1≤pi≤N$$$1 \leq p_i \leq N$$$), indicating that a ghost with energy pi$$$p_i$$$ is placed in room i$$$i$$$. The third line contains M$$$M$$$ integers t0,t1,…tM−1$$$t_0, t_1, \dots t_{M-1}$$$ (0≤ti≤105$$$0 \leq t_i \leq 10^5$$$), the second when the people arrive to the house. All people arrive at different time.
output: Print M$$$M$$$ lines. In the j$$$j$$$-th line print two space-separated integers: the number of the room where the person with number (j−1)$$$(j-1)$$$ get scared and the second when they get scared. If the person abandons the house without being scared in any room, print two −1$$$-1$$$ separated by a space.

legend.ai: 鬼屋是万圣节最受欢迎的活动之一。Bob 计划在今年万圣节开设自己的鬼屋。他的鬼屋由 N$$$N$$$ 个房间组成，编号从 0$$$0$$$ 到 N−1$$$N-1$$$。
Bob 有 N$$$N$$$ 只鬼，每只鬼都有一个介于 1$$$1$$$ 和 N$$$N$$$ 之间且互不相同的能量值。能量为 x$$$x$$$ 的鬼可以连续活跃 x$$$x$$$ 秒，之后需要休息 x$$$x$$$ 秒才能再次活跃。但还有一个问题：如果这只鬼在活跃期间吓到了一个人，那么它需要立即休息 x$$$x$$$ 秒才能再次活跃，因为吓人对鬼来说很累。
在决定将鬼放在哪里之前，Bob 想要模拟一些场景。一个场景由一个排列 p0,p1,…,pN−1$$$p_0, p_1, \dots, p_{N-1}$$$ 和一个序列 t0,t1,…,tM−1$$$t_0, t_1, \dots, t_{M-1}$$$ 定义，其中排列表示 Bob 将能量为 pi$$$p_i$$$ 的鬼放置在房间 i$$$i$$$ 中，序列表示人们到达鬼屋的时间。
如果一个人在 tj$$$t_j$$$ 秒到达鬼屋，那么他会在 tj$$$t_j$$$ 秒访问格子 0$$$0$$$。当一个人在第 T$$$T$$$ 秒访问格子 i$$$i$$$ 时，有以下两种情况：
如果房间中有一只活跃的鬼，那么这个人会被吓到并立即离开鬼屋。该鬼会在第 T+1$$$T+1$$$ 秒开始休息。
否则，这个人会在第 T+1$$$T+1$$$ 秒访问房间 i+1$$$i+1$$$；如果 i+1=N$$$i+1=N$$$，则会离开鬼屋。
给定一个场景，请帮助 Bob 模拟这一过程，并找出人们被吓到的房间以及发生这种情况的时间。注意，所有鬼在第 0$$$0$$$ 秒时都处于活跃状态。

input.ai: 第一行包含两个整数 N$$$N$$$ 和 M$$$M$$$(1≤N,M≤105$$$1 \leq N, M \leq 10^5$$$)。第二行包含一个大小为 N$$$N$$$ 的排列 p0,p1,…,pN−1$$$p_0, p_1, \dots, p_{N-1}$$$(1≤pi≤N$$$1 \leq p_i \leq N$$$)，表示能量为 pi$$$p_i$$$ 的幽灵位于房间 i$$$i$$$ 中。第三行包含 M$$$M$$$ 个整数 t0,t1,…tM−1$$$t_0, t_1, \dots t_{M-1}$$$(0≤ti≤105$$$0 \leq t_i \leq 10^5$$$)，表示人们到达房屋的时刻(秒)。所有人的到达时刻各不相同。

output.ai: 输出 M$$$M$$$ 行。第 j$$$j$$$ 行输出两个用空格分隔的整数：编号为(j−1)$$$(j-1)$$$ 的人受到惊吓的房间编号，以及他们受到惊吓的时刻(秒)。如果某人在任何房间都没有受到惊吓就离开了房屋，则输出两个用空格分隔的 −1$$$-1$$$。
